studySummary.description: A concise two-sentence summary of the key findings.

zebrafishStrain.description: Specific zebrafish strain used, e.g. 'AB', 'TU', 'Wild-type', or 'Not Applicable'.

testedConcentrations.description: Tested concentrations with units, e.g. '10 µg/L', '100 nM', '0 (control)'.

renewal.description: Solution renewal regime (e.g. 'static', 'semi-static daily', 'flow-through') or 'no information'.

hasTranscriptomics.description: True if the study uses transcriptomics (RNA-Seq, microarrays, qPCR profiling).

lc50Values.description: LC50 values per chemical with units, or empty if not reported.

ec50Values.description: EC50 values per chemical with units, or empty if not reported.

vtgConclusion.description: One-sentence conclusion on vitellogenin (VTG) induction. 'Not assessed' if not measured.

estrogenConclusion.description: One-sentence statement on estrogen-signalling markers (erα, erβ, cyp19a, cyp19b). 'Not assessed' if none measured.

hormoneConclusion.description: One-sentence conclusion on circulating hormone changes (E2, T, etc.). 'Not assessed' if none measured.

neuroendocrineConclusion.description: One-sentence statement on neuroendocrine markers (kiss1, kiss1r, gnrh3). 'Not assessed' if none measured.

endpoints.description: Return ONE object for EACH endocrine endpoint the study actually measured — separately per sex and per treatment/concentration group when the study reports them separately. Cover these endpoint families WHERE MEASURED: (1) VTG — vitellogenin (vtg1) mRNA or VTG protein; (2) Estrogen-signalling genes — esr1 (erα), esr2 (erβ), cyp19a1a (cyp19a, ovarian aromatase), cyp19a1b (cyp19b, brain aromatase); (3) Hormone levels — Estradiol (E2), Testosterone (T), 11-Ketotestosterone, Progestin/17,20β-DHP, FSH, LH, T3, T4, Cortisol, and the E2/T ratio; (4) Neuroendocrine genes — kiss1, kiss1r, gnrh3. Do NOT create rows for endpoints that were not measured in this study.

endpoint.description: The specific marker, e.g. 'VTG protein', 'vtg1 mRNA', 'esr1 (erα)', 'cyp19a1b (brain aromatase)', 'Estradiol (E2)', 'kiss1'.

treatmentGroup.description: Concentration/treatment group this result refers to, e.g. '10 µg/L', or 'Overall' if not group-resolved.

matrix.description: Sample matrix, e.g. 'Whole body homogenate', 'Plasma', 'Tissue', or 'NA'.

direction.description: Direction of change vs control: 'Increase', 'No change', 'Decrease', or 'N/A'. Do NOT include time or duration.

evidence.description: For each key finding, the exact text snippet copied verbatim from the PDF that supports it. Used for verification.
